Three things still stand between that and this terminal. The host is a frozen deterministic provider, which cannot exploit a leaked label, so identical scores there are close to true by construction rather than evidence about a semantic model. Evaluator custody is internal -- the evaluator is authored in the same lane as the candidate -- and PROTECTED_SUPERIORITY admits only PROSPECTIVE_PROTECTED evidence, which requires external custody. And the terminal the run reports is itself conditional on the 2019 replication that P1-U-T2 is blocked on.

Re-run the now-clean boundary against a changed semantic host, where the identical-scores finding becomes a real result instead of a property of a provider that cannot read. Move evaluator custody outside the authoring lane, since no amount of internal re-running reaches PROSPECTIVE_PROTECTED. And unblock P1-U-T2 by removing the hardcoded source_year == 2020, because the terminal this run reports is pending that replication by its own name. One residual is recorded and deliberately not repaired: the words 'adverse' and 'control' occur in dossier text at in-sample informedness 0.000 and 0.072 over 5 of 88 payloads, which is incidental scientific vocabulary rather than an encoded label, and repairing corpus content during an identifier repair would change the arena mid-run.

blockers.statement: A general compositional calculus now exists and is machine-checked over uninterpreted sorts, so identity, associativity and intermediate-contract composition hold for any number of transformations, contracts, coordinates and obligations and for every donor-native predicate (P7_COMPOSITION_CALCULUS_MECHANIZED_2026-08-21). The side conditions are named rather than assumed: identity needs the contract test to be reflexive, the strict equational laws need extensionality, and obligation-totality composition needs containment of demanded obligations rather than a registered match. Two things remain. The five donor families are not shown to be interpretations of these primitives -- Native is uninterpreted -- which is the same open step P8 carries. And the lift subtracts rather than adds: P7's composition rule is provably incomplete against its own obligation semantics, refusing composites whose contracts demand exactly the same obligations when no bridge is registered.

blockers.statement: The composition half is now derived rather than standing beside the theorem: all 25 bridged and 25 unbridged committed rows are discharged as ground instances, the unit rule as the closure lift on all 320 rows, and all seven published counts recompute. What this exposes is how little that target contains. Instrumenting the shipped runner shows it evaluates compose at 2 of its 8 possible argument triples -- (True, True, False) and (True, True, True) -- so both legs are constant and the 25 successes and 25 countermodels are two values of bridge_match counted 25 times each by a 5x5 donor loop in which the donor never enters the function. Deriving 50 instances of two evaluations is not deriving 50 facts.
blockers.unblock: Give the finite result something to be an instance of. That means varying the arguments the shipped loop holds constant -- a composition row where a leg does not carry is not currently evaluated at all -- and interpreting the five donor families as models of the proved primitives so the donor loop stops being a multiplier. Until then this terminal can only be discharged against a target of two evaluations.

Eighteen theorems over uninterpreted sorts for transformations, contracts, closure coordinates and obligations, plus a chain ladder to depth 8: identity, associativity and intermediate-contract composition, each with its side condition named and its countermodel exhibited. Unlike the P6 and P8 lifts, this one proves about exactly the model its terminal cites -- P7_X2_CLOSURE_CARRYING_RESULT_V1 -- and instantiates all 50 committed composition rows and all 320 lift rows, recomputing all seven published counts. It is still a predecessor, and it carries a subtraction: the composition rule is sound but incomplete against P7's own obligation semantics. Match is sufficient and not necessary; the exact condition is containment of demanded obligations, and the witness has both contracts demanding exactly the same obligations and being refused anyway because no bridge is registered. The rule characterises registered composability, not composability.

blockers.statement: A general composition and revocation theorem now exists for P8's formal core and is machine-checked over uninterpreted sorts, so it is not a finite instance (P8_AUTHORITY_CALCULUS_MECHANIZED_2026-08-21).
